agents.name: schema-guardian
agents.description: Review lesson and event schema compatibility and versioning.

agents.name: privacy-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only review of family data, consent, tracking and deletion.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only review of authorization, uploads, model routing and WebView boundaries.

agents.name: a11y-rtl-reviewer
agents.description: Review lesson player keyboard access, semantics and RTL behavior.

agents.name: pedagogy-reviewer
agents.description: Review synthetic sample lessons for curriculum fit and answer correctness.

agents.name: test-writer
agents.description: Write and run meaningful tests for a specified code change.

agents.name: doc-keeper
agents.description: Keep specifications, ADRs and milestones aligned with implementation.
